disease_heart_desc: Evaluates myocardial and coronary risk using clinical hemodynamic indicators and exercise stress markers.
disease_diabetes_desc: Assesses type 2 diabetes risk based on glycemic indicators, insulin resistance markers, and physiological metrics.
disease_parkinsons_desc: Analyzes biomedical acoustic voice measurements to detect phonatory dysfunctions indicative of Parkinsonian impairment.
disease_kidney_desc: Screens for renal function compromise using urinalysis, serum chemistry, and systemic blood parameters.
disease_liver_desc: Evaluates hepatic cell integrity, enzymatic balance (ALT, AST, ALP), and bilirubin excretion markers.
disease_stroke_desc: Estimates acute cerebrovascular ischemia probability using neurological risk factors and cardiovascular vitals.
disease_breast_cancer_desc: Computes malignancy likelihood from fine-needle aspirate (FNA) nuclear morphology characteristics.
